items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: there were Southerners in it, Harry James from Texas and Dave Mathews from Oklahoma

ctx.x: Oh, no, the cooperation was good in the band. We were like brothers, the whole outfit. Because everybody knew what was happening, you know. And the Goodman Band, the band was composed of -- there were Southerners in it, Harry James from Texas and Dave Mathews from Oklahoma, and there were Jews and Christians and Lionel Hampton and I represented

the Negro in the band. And Goodman was Jewish, and some of the guys were Italians. And Ziggy Elman, I think, was Jewish background. But the thing was as solid as a family, the Goodman thing. We were all there, just like brothers.
